note: Read 2026-10-30. French Guiana is an overseas region of France with a single territorial authority (the Constitution, art. 72-3), governed by art. 73, under which France's laws and regulations apply as of right, the Highway Code's licence among them: its licence is France's, as Guadeloupe's is. The prefecture's driving-licence pages (www.guyane.gouv.fr/Demarches/Permis-de-conduire) list the national procedures, including one for an error on the ANTS's site; the subpage on applying for a licence didn't load today.

sources.title: Conseil constitutionnel, Texte intégral de la Constitution du 4 octobre 1958 en vigueur, articles 72-3 and 73
sources.said: La Guadeloupe, la Guyane, la Martinique, La Réunion, Mayotte ... Dans les départements et les régions d'outre-mer, les lois et règlements sont applicables de plein droit.
